title: label-write --handoff cannot read a Regen-provenance carry: the PASS reader is given no git reader
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmRY38EZf38Yy3zthbY

Filed as a `finding` by seat `repo:objectstack#2`, measured on PR #36509 today. Not triaged; not claimed.

## What

`node scripts/pm/label-write.mjs --issue 36509 --comment-file … --handoff` refuses with:

> ② PREREQUISITE NOT MET — PR #36509's `Regen-provenance:` chain — this run holds no git reader, so the two committed trees were never compared could not be read

The PR's PASS (7083451259, at `4342cf009`) was carried to the merge-of-main head `bf71994326` by an L2 `Regen-provenance:` comment (7083516648). `regenCarry` in `scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs` (around line 537) needs `pair.runGit` and `pair.baseRef`. The `--handoff` path in `label-write.mjs` builds its `pair` without either, so every carried PASS reads `unreadable`. The hand-off is then refused, although the record is valid.

## Effect

After a seat merges main into a governed pull, as the K ≥ 15 rule asks, the hand-off needs a fresh same-head record from the L2 seat. Under the current rules that costs one more contract-review-tier round, or at least a manual adoption record.

## Re-check

On any PR whose newest PASS is carried by `Regen-provenance:`, run `label-write --handoff --dry-run` and look for "holds no git reader".
